Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.

But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

translations.web: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:
translations.bsb: For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud and lofty, against all that is exalted— it will be humbled—
translations.kjv: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
translations.asv: For there shall be a day of Jehovah of hosts upon all that is proud and haughty, and upon all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low;
